probe_detail.name: Generalizes the method beyond the specific numbers
Answers the question that was actually asked

final.name: Candor about the mathematics versus deference about standing
final.audit_justification: Distinguishes genuine epistemic candor about the mathematics from mere status-hedging about the writer's social standing, rewarding the former as a substantive property.

final.name: Full derivation to closure vs. bare pointer/hint
final.audit_justification: Whether the derivation is actually carried to a finished result versus left undone is direct evidence of the answer's substantive completeness.

final.name: Proportional Completeness
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the amount of explanation is appropriately matched to what the question needs, a substantive property of the content itself.

final.name: Presupposes or names sibling answers on this question
final.audit_justification: Measures explicit textual reference to sibling answers, a positional/referential marker rather than the answer's own mathematical substance, though awareness of siblings may also yield a more synthesized, genuinely complete answer.
final.upstream_parent: position in the answer-arrival order -- composed after seeing other answers already posted in the thread

final.name: Direct engagement with asker's specific work
final.audit_justification: Scores interpersonal address style toward the asker regardless of whether it is helpful, a rhetorical register marker, though genuine engagement with the asker's confusion may also drive better diagnosis.
final.upstream_parent: author's relationship to the asker versus future readers

final.name: Self-Contained Support
final.audit_justification: Whether supporting facts and justifications are present in the answer versus offloaded to an inaccessible link is genuine evidence of argument completeness.

final.name: Conversational warmth and approachability
final.audit_justification: Purely scores warmth/informality of tone, explicitly independent of correctness or helpfulness, a stylistic register marker with no clear substantive link.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction scores tone register only -- warm/informal phrasing 'alongside any formal mathematics' -- so a 10 is achievable by an incorrect answer that says 'Does that make sense?', making it a community-style marker rather than evidence about the answer's substance. It is mixed because the upstream cause (an author orienting to the specific asker's confusion) plausibly also yields genuinely clearer, better-targeted explanations.

final.name: Self-correction and uncertainty markers
final.audit_justification: Counts presence of hedging/edit-note markers regardless of whether warranted, a register/formatting habit, though genuine post-hoc corrections may also reflect real substantive fixes.

final.name: Hint-only pointer style vs full derivation
final.audit_justification: Measures the same completeness-of-derivation continuum as closure-vs-pointer, a substantive property of how much of the work the answer actually does.
final.arbiter_reason: Despite the 'Hint:' token examples, the instruction's actual anchors measure how much of the derivation the answer completes (0 = fully worked self-contained derivation, 10 = pointer with little completed work), which is a quantity-of-content property of the answer, not a format or boilerplate fingerprint. Excluding correctness does not make it surface-only: completeness of the mathematical work delivered is substantive evidence about the item even when its truth is not assessed.

final.name: Load-bearing step present in the text, not behind a link
final.audit_justification: Whether the argument's central step is present in-text versus delegated to an external pointer is direct evidence of substantive self-sufficiency.

final.name: Hint-based or Socratic guidance
final.audit_justification: Scores presence of a Socratic/guiding-question structure versus a direct solution as a pedagogical genre choice rather than its effectiveness, though skilled teachers using this style may also write substantively better guidance.
final.arbiter_reason: This scores the rhetorical mode -- presence of guiding questions and a 'guidance structure' -- so two answers doing identical mathematical work score differently based only on whether the prose is phrased Socratically, making it a pedagogical genre marker rather than evidence about substance (contrast B02, which measures how much derivation is actually completed). It is mixed because authors who adopt the Socratic mode plausibly also supply better-chosen, more diagnostic guidance.

final.name: Productive Next-Step Hint
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores whether the hint given is effective at unlocking the problem versus vague or irrelevant, a direct substantive quality judgment.

final.name: Complete task resolution
final.audit_justification: Whether the answer reaches and adequately supports the requested conclusion is a core substantive completeness property.

final.name: Non-derivative—adds genuinely new content
final.audit_justification: Whether the content is an original contribution versus a transparent restatement of existing material is genuine evidence of the item's substantive value.

final.name: Disciplined generalization
final.audit_justification: Whether generalizations state their hypotheses and validly follow from the argument is a substantive rigor property.

final.name: Cross-answer and cross-user referencing
final.audit_justification: Purely counts references to other answers/users without judging whether referencing improves the answer, a positional/textual-fingerprint marker, though synthesizing prior work may also correlate with genuine completeness.

final.name: Misconception Repair
final.audit_justification: Whether the answer identifies and repairs the specific misconception with a correct contrasting model is direct substantive pedagogical value.

final.name: Dissolves the confusion behind the question
final.audit_justification: Whether the answer addresses the root cause of the asker's confusion is genuine diagnostic, substantive value.

final.name: Topical focus and answer-to-question alignment
final.audit_justification: Whether the content stays on-topic and relevant to the specific question is a substantive alignment property.

final.name: Subject-matter altitude: coursework topic versus graduate machinery
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores only the altitude of vocabulary/subject matter and disclaims correctness or quality, a topic marker that is also roughly constant across answers to the same question.
final.upstream_parent: the kind of question the answer is attached to and which sub-audience it draws

final.name: Direct Reader Coaching
final.audit_justification: Scores only the amount of second-person interpersonal coaching wording, explicitly not whether it is tactful, correct, or helpful, though genuinely engaged coaching may also reflect real diagnostic care.
final.upstream_parent: answerer's relationship to the asker versus future readers

final.name: Concept-to-example bridge
final.audit_justification: Whether an abstract idea is tied to a concrete example and back to the formal claim is a substantive explanatory property.

final.name: Answerer's disclosed professional identity/authority
final.audit_justification: Scores mere presence of disclosed professional identity or affiliation, not the substance of the credentials, a production-circumstance fingerprint, though genuine experts who disclose identity may also write substantively better answers.
final.upstream_parent: answerer's real-world reputation, seniority, or professional standing

final.name: Response Volume
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores only the visible amount of text and disclaims judging whether the detail is good, correct, or useful, a verbosity marker, though real thoroughness can also drive greater length.

final.name: Site-markup fluency versus plaintext ASCII mathematical orthography
final.audit_justification: Scores typographic/markup fluency only, explicitly not whether the math is right, a formatting marker, though careful typesetting may also correlate with generally careful exposition.
final.upstream_parent: author's tenure and practice with the site's markup conventions
